- main:
  - heading "We're here to give you the space to create." [level=1]
  - paragraph:
    - text: Creators deserve more than rented platforms and borrowed audiences.
    - text: CosmicApp gives you structure, clarity, and full ownership — without compromise.
  - heading "our space mission" [level=1]:
    - generic: our space mission
  - paragraph
  - paragraph:
    - text: We’re building for creators who are done playing by someone else’s rules.
    - text: We don’t believe your audience should belong to a feed. We don’t believe your income should depend on reach you can’t control. And we definitely don’t believe you should duct-tape your business together just to make it work.
    - text: "So we’re building something different: a place where your products live under your name, your audience isn’t rented, and your growth isn’t dictated by a platform that can change overnight."
    - text: No marketplaces. No competing on the same shelf. No building on borrowed land. Just a focused foundation for creators who want control — and plan to keep it.
  - heading "our values" [level=1]:
    - generic: our values
  - paragraph: The principles behind everything we build.
  - heading "Ownership First" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Your audience and revenue should belong to you.
  - heading "Clarity Over Chaos" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Fewer tools. Less friction. More focus.
  - heading "Quality Over Noise" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Build things that last — not what trends.
  - heading "Creator-Led" [level=3]
  - paragraph: Real creators shape the platform.
  - heading "Focused Foundation" [level=3]
  - paragraph: One system. Not ten tools duct-taped together.
  - heading "WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT" [level=1]:
    - generic: WHAT MAKES US DIFFERENT
  - paragraph: We’re not building another marketplace or a pile of tools. Galactica is built for creators who want ownership, focus, and a cleaner way to sell their work.
  - list:
    - generic: "01"
    - heading "No marketplace noise" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Your products aren’t placed beside competitors or ranked by an algorithm.
    - generic: "02"
    - heading "Your audience stays yours" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Build direct relationships without renting attention from someone else’s feed.
    - generic: "03"
    - heading "Built for focused selling" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Courses, downloads, and consultations live inside one clear creator system.
    - generic: "04"
    - heading "Less tool sprawl" [level=3]
    - paragraph: Replace disconnected workflows with a foundation that feels intentional.
  - generic: “
  - paragraph: "We built Galactica for creators who are done compromising. You shouldn’t have to trade ownership for convenience or clarity for complexity. Our mission is simple: give creators the foundation they deserve so they can build, sell, and grow — on their own terms. This is just the beginning."
  - generic: TATI, CEO
